nc6069b1202.headline: Cuts in municipal investments affect builders. Cancellation of contracts has already affected a third of companies
nc6069b1202.summary: About 35% of Czech construction companies faced contract cancellations and 59% experienced delays due to reduced municipal investment budgets.
nc6069b1202.why: Public investment is a major driver of construction sector activity; cuts can slow economic growth and affect related industries.
